instruction.name: bnez
instruction.description: Branch if rj is non-zero (measured not taken).

throughput.name: 8 not-taken branches
throughput.asm: bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 0' --asm 'bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0; bnez $r4, 0'
throughput.notes: Not-taken branches run at 0.5 CPI. The marginal cost measured against a loop-only baseline improves with the number of static branches because one branch rides the loop branch slot (0.437 at 8 static branches for integer compares, converging to 0.5; 0.874 converging to 1.0 for FCC compares), so the saturated rate is recorded. Both ends are recorded as separate experiments, so the range is the spread between them.

throughput.name: 8 taken branches
throughput.asm: bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 8 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1' --asm 'bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4; bnez $r4, 4'
throughput.notes: 8 taken branches retires one per cycle while the static footprint fits the BTB and degrades to three cycles per branch once it does not; the pair of experiments records both, and the range on this entry keeps the BTB behaviour visible.

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Taken-branch throughput spans 1 CPI (BTB-friendly) to 3 CPI (static stream beyond BTB capacity); not-taken branches run at 0.5 CPI.
